failure_modes.mode: Settings renderer is undefined after direct refresh
failure_modes.cause: Core deferred script starts API fetch before later deferred scripts finish; fast response draws too early
failure_modes.effect: Blank Settings and live updates never connect
failure_modes.detection: Hold studios.js while fulfilling overview immediately
failure_modes.mitigation: Gate startup on DOMContentLoaded, after deferred dependency execution

failure_modes.mode: Portfolio/writing hash silently falls back to jobs
failure_modes.cause: Hash is resolved before studios.js adds those views
failure_modes.effect: Direct links or refresh lose requested view
failure_modes.detection: Delayed Studio/NHS scripts with direct cover/portfolio entry and repeated refresh
failure_modes.mitigation: Resolve hash only inside dependency-ready initialization

failure_modes.mode: A failed module download still produces undefined functions
failure_modes.cause: DOMContentLoaded fires after a failed script request
failure_modes.effect: Broken page and raw implementation error
failure_modes.mitigation: Check required renderer availability before any initial requests and provide explicit reload/classic-dashboard recovery

failure_modes.mode: Initialization is repeated and adds duplicate polling streams
failure_modes.cause: Multiple readiness notifications or manual calls
failure_modes.effect: Duplicate refresh requests and SSE sessions
failure_modes.detection: Track initial overview/auth requests and invoke initializer again after ready
failure_modes.mitigation: One-shot listener and idempotent startup guard
